title: Japanese government pushes reduction of consumption tax to 1% for food from 2027
summary: The government initiative to reduce consumption tax on food to 1% advances without political consensus, with criticism about lack of funding and fiscal impact.

title: Japanese writer Keigo Higashino, author of 'The Devotion of Suspect X', dies at 68
summary: The prolific Japanese novelist, whose mystery works achieved worldwide fame and multiple film and television adaptations, has died leaving a great literary legacy.

title: Nikkei index plunges more than 2,700 points due to massive sell-off of semiconductor stocks
summary: Fear of overvaluation in the technology sector triggered a wave of selling on Wall Street that spread to Tokyo and Seoul, affecting major chip manufacturers.

title: Japan considers requiring stalkers to use GPS devices to prevent crimes
summary: As part of emergency measures against harassment, the government studies the installation of location-tracking bracelets that alert victims if the perpetrator approaches.

title: Trump threatens to attack Iran if diplomatic talks fail
summary: The US president is optimistic about progress in negotiations, but warns that he will resort to military force if an agreement with Tehran is not reached.

title: Japanese Coast Guard searches international school over boat capsizing in Henoko
summary: The raid on Doshisha school comes after complaints from the families of students killed in the accident off the US base in Okinawa.

title: Minimum wage negotiations in Japan stall around 1,100 yen per hour
summary: The tripartite commission has yet to reach an agreement due to differences between representatives of workers and employers over the increase in the national minimum wage.

title: Japanese speed skater Miho Takagi receives National Honor Award
summary: The Japanese government grants the highest civilian honor to the ice speedster, holder of ten Olympic medals.

title: Former NGO director arrested for alleged illegal charges in organ transplants in Japan
summary: Police arrested again the former director of a non-profit organization accused of receiving payments from patients in exchange for facilitating organ transplants.

title: Kei Nishikori to play US Open mixed doubles alongside Naomi Osaka
summary: The Japanese tennis player, who announced his retirement after the tournament, will compete in his first official event since announcing his farewell, partnering with fellow Japanese star.

title: Japan accumulates record 2.43 million tons of rice in stock
summary: The inventory of rice for consumption reaches historic levels while the government decides not to repurchase emergency rice to avoid further oversupply.

title: Alternative government seat law gains support in Japanese opposition
summary: The project to create a sub-capital for emergencies advances in parliament with the backing of some opposition parties, although the prime minister is reluctant to create a committee of experts.
